# `CompassCalibration`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Progress and result of the compass (magnetometer) calibration worker.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, notifyCompassCalibrationSector @0x1285e0, compassCalibrationThreadFunc @0x12c370, scopeMoveRound @0x184160, getMSensorData @0x134ae0 (sector math @0x134cac-0x134cfc, auto-stop thresholds, sample de-duplication @0x134c2c-0x134c64), packCompassSensorData @0x126700 (sole caller get_device_state @0xf2b80, both builds), NotifyStateWithRoute @0xb15d0 (64-bit build); firmware 9.75 fail codes from the 9.75 reports (getCompassFitFailureCode @0x1571b0, scopeMoveRoundThreadFunc @0x13c590, 64-bit build) |

Broadcast on TCP 4700 (channel I). The calibration worker started by start_compass_calibration sends terminal states complete or fail through the state-with-route helper (family SR: code and error only when the supplied code is greater than 0); the magnetometer sampling callback sends working updates carrying sector progress (sector_id, covered, total, samples) and a route. The heading circle is divided into 12 sectors of 30 degrees numbered 0-11 from heading 0 (total 12). A working event is sent once each time a new sector is first covered, so a run sends at most 12; there is no other throttle or timer. A magnetometer sample within 4 raw units in both x and y of an already kept sample is dropped and cannot cover a sector; at most 2000 samples are kept. This is the only compass event: no periodic heading event exists, and the compass reading is otherwise available only from get_device_state. The device stops sampling and calculates on its own when all 12 sectors are covered and no new sector has been seen for 2 s (after at least 20 samples), or 65 s after start. Firmware 9.31: the calculation thread ends with complete or fail with code 0, so its fail carries no code or error; the move-round step fails with 241, 300 or 320. Firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0: the fail event carries code and error: 560 and 561 from the rotation (communication, rotation), 562 rotation timeout, 563 sampling gate or sector coverage failure (set in the sampling and coverage branch, never by the fit classifier), 564 magnetic interference or field instability, 565 generic failure (default, fewer than 10 de-duplicated samples, or a failed configuration write); 561 is also set when the automatic rotation fails with no code stored; the first code set wins. A fit fails when the residual spread exceeds 10.0 or the maximum deviation exceeds 25.0 around the 50.0 reference, the matrix is near-singular or its condition number exceeds 10, or fewer than 6 of 12 sectors are covered (see the polar-alignment chapter). A client MUST NOT require code on fail, and SHOULD read it when present. Terminal route ancestry is unresolved. Family: SR plus custom. APK: recognized by the event-type table (route check disabled for this name).

Side effects: Observation only.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"CompassCalibration"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | working on sector progress; complete or fail from the worker at the end. One of: `working`, `complete`, `fail`. [READ] |
| `sector_id` | integer | if working sector update | - | Sector newly covered, floor(heading / 30 degrees) mod 12, numbered 0-11 from heading 0. Range: >= 0, <= 11. [READ] |
| `covered` | integer | if working sector update | - | Number of sectors covered so far. Range: >= 1, <= 12. [READ] |
| `total` | integer | if working sector update | - | Total number of sectors, always 12. Fixed value `12`. [READ] |
| `samples` | integer | if working sector update | - | Sample count (converted from an unsigned size). Range: >= 0. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | no | - | Function-parent path. Present on the working callback and on SR terminal sends; may be empty. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if supplied code greater than 0 (family SR) | - | Failure code. Firmware 9.31: 241, 300 and 320 from the move-round step; absent on a calculation fail. Firmware 9.75: 560 to 565 on fail (see the error table). [READ] |
| `error` | string | if as code | - | Message for code. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, sector-progress - READ shape, not captured; values invented:

```json
{"Event":"CompassCalibration","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","sector_id":5,"covered":6,"total":12,"samples":240,"route":[]}
```

Event, complete - READ shape, not captured:

```json
{"Event":"CompassCalibration","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","route":[]}
```

Event, fail-9.75 - READ shape, not captured; values invented:

```json
{"Event":"CompassCalibration","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"fail","code":564,"error":"magnetic interference detected, remove magnetic objects and retry","route":[]}
```
